Kimberly — thanks for the write-up and attaching the sheet. Quick notes after reviewing against current band and comp pool:

- Base: $165k is at the low-mid of our SDE-II band for West Coast hires. Given the candidate's 6+ years and a couple strong system design loops, I'd recommend $170k to avoid counteroffers.
- RSUs: 8,000 @ 4-yr is acceptable but skews toward cash-light candidates. If you prefer lower base, we could move to 10,000 RSUs with slightly reduced base — but for speed, raising base is cleaner.
- Signing bonus: $7.5k is fine. If we push base to $170k, keep signing bonus at $5k to preserve equity budget.
- Bonus target: 15% is standard. Good to note pro-rata details in the offer.

One operational ask: include an explicit clause for remote-first role and expected travel (~up to 10% annually).

No blockers on start date. Once Karthik confirms HC-1427 coverage, I sign off.

—Marissa
